description: Calculate Vedic divisional charts (vargas) with Moon Dasha: any of the 26 the moondasha.com report draws (D1, D9, D2, D3, D4, D7, D10, D12, D16, D20, D24, D27, D30, D40, D45, D60, D5, D6, D8, D11, D72, D81, D108, D144, D150, D300; default the D9, Navamsa). Each chart gives its Ascendant and the nine grahas with sign, whole-sign house from that chart's own Ascendant, sign lord and relationship, dignity by sign, Vargottama and Bhavottama, what the chart is read for, and the span of birth times that keeps its Ascendant sign, plus a link to the charts on moondasha.com. The higher the division, the more exact the birth time must be: the D60 Ascendant changes sign every few minutes, and the D150's and the D300's within about a minute. Needs the birth date, the local birth time and the birthplace (a place_id from find_place); set time_is_approximate when the time is a guess. The figures are Moon Dasha's calculations. Interpret them with care and never predict death, illness, a child's sex, markets, elections or court cases.

ayanamsa.description: Default Lahiri. Krishnamurti is the KP ayanamsa.

chart_style.description: How the card draws the charts: North Indian (default) or South Indian. Set south only when the person asks for it.

charts.description: The divisional charts wanted, in order, any of D1, D9, D2, D3, D4, D7, D10, D12, D16, D20, D24, D27, D30, D40, D45, D60, D5, D6, D8, D11, D72, D81, D108, D144, D150, D300 (D1 is the birth chart, for comparison). Default: the D9 (Navamsa) alone.

d2_method.description: The D2 (Hora) scheme: parashara (default; the Sun and Moon horas) or uma_shambhu. Set uma_shambhu only when the person asks for it.

node.description: Rahu and Ketu by the mean node (default) or the true node.

place_id.description: The place_id find_place returned for the birthplace.

time.description: Local clock time at the birthplace, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS. Required: if the person does not know it, ask for their best guess and set time_is_approximate.

time_is_approximate.description: Set when the birth time is a guess: each chart then says whether its houses hold an hour either side.

name: divisional_charts
title: Divisional charts
